ios.desc:
Dally gives you one clear thing to do each day based on the interests you choose.

Pick categories like Adventure, Wellness, Learning, Food, Home, Social, Culture, Creative, and Tech. Dally turns those interests into daily actions that are short, useful, and easy to complete.

When you finish a day, save a note, a photo, or both. Your completed days become a visual rhythm you can revisit through weekly summaries, progress cards, and memory wallpapers.

All themes, fonts, widgets, image generation, wallpaper exports, and sharing tools are included.

Features:
Interest-based daily actions
Simple note and photo memory capture
Weekly, monthly, and yearly summary views
Memory wallpaper generation
Themes and font styles
Home screen widgets
Local progress tracking for your 365-day journey
